description: This file defines the AppUserReadPlatformService interface, which declares methods for retrieving user data and performing user-related queries within the user administration module of the application.

classes.name: AppUserReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for reading user data and user-related queries in the system.

methods.name: retrieveAllUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all user data records.

methods.name: retrieveSearchTemplate
methods.description: Provides a search template with default or sample data for user search operations.

methods.name: retrieveNewUserDetails
methods.description: Retrieves default details necessary for creating a new user.

methods.name: retrieveUser
methods.description: Fetches details for a specific user identified by userId.

methods.name: isUsernameExist
methods.description: Checks whether a given username already exists in the system.
